items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-034: Server-Side Request Forgery in Dashboard RSS Widget
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to server-side request forgery in the RSS widget of the dashboard.

items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-033: Information Disclosure in File Dump Controller
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to information disclosure in the file dump controller.

items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-032: Unrestricted File Upload in Form Framework
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to unrestricted file uploads in the Form Framework.

items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-031: Cache Flooding in Page Cache Handling
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to denial of service through page cache flooding.

items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-030: Open Redirection in URL Sanitization
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to open redirection in URL sanitization.

items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-029: Information Disclosure in Form Framework
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to Information Disclosure in the Form Framework.

items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-028: Information Disclosure in Image Processing
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to information disclosure in image processing.

items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-027: Missing Authentication in Installer
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to missing authentication in the installer.

items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-026: Missing Authorization in Online Media Handling
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to missing authorization when adding online media in the backend.

items.title: TYPO3-CORE-SA-2026-025: Path Traversal in Import/Export Module
items.summary: It has been discovered that TYPO3 CMS is susceptible to path traversal in the Import/Export module.

items.title: TYPO3 14.3.12, 13.4.40, 12.4.52, 11.5.57 and 10.4.63 security releases published
items.summary: The versions 14.3.12, 13.4.40, 12.4.52, 11.5.57 and 10.4.63 of the TYPO3 Enterprise Content Management System have just been released.

items.title: SEAL Ecosystem Moves From Search to Answers: Community Budget Report
items.summary: Version 3.0 of the Index extension and 2.0 releases of SEAL and SEAL AI bring configuration-driven indexing, external content fetching, WCAG 2.2 templates, chunked embeddings, and a read-only MCP server that makes TYPO3 content available to AI agents.

items.title: TYPO3-PSA-2026-002: Important TYPO3 Core Security Release Pre-Announcement
items.summary: The TYPO3 Security Team pre-announces important security releases.

items.title: ELTS From TYPO3 V13 Onwards: What’s Changing
items.summary: Which of your TYPO3 installations are actually covered by ELTS? From January 1, 2028, ELTS for TYPO3 v13 will be delivered only via download and Composer, secured by one token per instance. Frank Nägler explains what’s changing, why GitHub access is ending, and how to prepare your projects.

items.title: TYPO3 Unit Kickoff: New Structure, First Roles, and How to Join
items.summary: Representatives of all six new TYPO3 Units met on 4–5 November 2026 to put the new governance structure into practice. They agreed on a preliminary lineup of Coordinators and Deputies and prepared proposals for the TYPO3 v15 roadmap. The Units are now inviting contributors to join as Members or Supporters.

items.title: TYPO3 14.3.11 and 13.4.39 maintenance releases published
items.summary: The versions 14.3.11 and 13.4.39 of the TYPO3 Enterprise Content Management System have just been released.

items.title: From CMS to Content Intelligence: Fabian Stein on Enterprise Content at Scale
items.summary: When hundreds of editors work across thousands of pages, do you really know what’s on your website? At the first TYPO3 North America Summit, Fabian Stein, CEO of punkt.de, explained why content is now operational infrastructure, and what it takes to move from content chaos to content observability.

items.title: Extbase Backend Modules: From Registration to a Working Module
items.summary: The TYPO3 Documentation Team has published the second chapter of its community-funded Extbase documentation work. Two example modules, one with and one without a page tree, show where a module gets its storage folder, TypoScript, and language.

items.title: Cookieless Tracking with TYPO3 Analytics: Unravel User Behaviour in Your System
items.summary: Up to 80% of your visitors go uncounted. Learn in this article why descriptive metrics usually fall short and how integrated behavioural analytics closes the gaps.

items.title: TYPO3 Association Board Meeting Protocol (14 October 2026)
items.summary: Preparations for the Extraordinary General Assembly and the new TYPO3 Units were underway. The board also heard about a finalized partnership with the European Open Source Academy and ongoing work on Cyber Resilience Act obligations with the Security Team.

items.title: TYPO3-EXT-SA-2026-038: Broken Access Control in extension "Frontend User Registration" (sf_register)
items.summary: It has been discovered that the extension "Frontend User Registration" (sf_register) is vulnerable to Broken Access Control.

items.title: TYPO3-EXT-SA-2026-037: Multiple vulnerabilities in extension "Mail" (mail)
items.summary: It has been discovered that the extension "Mail" (mail) is vulnerable to Open Redirection, Information Disclosure, Broken Access Control, Server-Side Request Forgery and Cross-Site Scripting.

items.title: This Month in TYPO3: October, 2026
items.summary: October was the month TYPO3 rewrote its own rulebook. Association members approved Units and a Unit Cooperation Panel, a heavy security week asked everyone to patch extensions and PHP, and new tooling made TYPO3 easier for coding agents to understand.

items.title: The TYPO3 Suite Is Here: Early Access to What's Next in TYPO3
items.summary: Today we're introducing the TYPO3 Suite: early access to selected TYPO3 features, with manufacturer responsibility from the TYPO3 Company. Here's what launched today, and what comes next.

items.title: TYPO3 Contribution in Numbers: October 2026
items.summary: See the full recap of TYPO3's October core contributions with 85 contributors, 467 reviews, bug fixes, features, and a big thank-you to our developers.
